method: Adversarial oracle audit; harness treated as defendant. Every file read in full across 5 parallel batches. Oracle taxonomy {true|pseudo|metamorphic|heuristic|proxy|no-oracle-smoke}; 7 smell patterns counted with file:line.

totals.security_headline: Positive content-forgery IS caught (real tamper->INVALID metamorphic tests exist in test_signature_roundtrip.cpp:146/204 and test_signature_security_phase2.cpp:235). The security ROT is in the trust/policy/attack-neutralization layers: (1) 21 named-CVE replays whose sole oracle is a wall-clock bound around a catch-all try/catch; (2) certificate trust-chain never positively validated (all fixtures self-signed -> assertions are tautological ORs); (3) DocMDP enforcement only grep-checked for byte presence, no disallowed-edit-is-flagged test; (4) OCSP/CRL freshness 'rejection' tests masked by a permanently-UntrustedChain fixture (two tests' own comments concede it); (5) hostile-JS/SSRF/redaction tests assert neutralization in their NAMES but only prove no-crash.

per_file.note: 21 named-CVE replays share one oracle (verifySafeOpen:62 = EXPECT_LT timing bound around a catch-all try/catch at 57-59). Proves nothing about neutralization.
3 assertion-free bodies (127/134/140); sole EXPECT is corpus-size>=3 (tautology). PKCS7 verify path exercised, nothing about output/safety asserted.
7 hostile-JS-API tests (651) are NO_THROW-only despite names promising 'Blocked/Rejected'. Only the 4 encryption tests (467-534) are TRUE oracles.
GoToR(211)/DataUri(249)/JsSubmitForm(487) NO_THROW-only; RedactionClearsUndoEvidence(179) greps for '/UndoStack' not the secret. SelfSignedCertReportedAsUntrusted(422) is genuine TRUE.
Negative-only: every assert = clean doc reports NOTHING. Zero positive-detection. A no-op scanner passes all 9.
STRONGEST file. Lexical UNC/file/scheme classifier with concrete TRUE/FALSE per input, mutation-killable. Only gap: dispatcher call site tested by predicate proxy (237).
DEP/ASLR/ImageLoad/StrictHandle query real GetProcessMitigationPolicy + assert bits. CfgStatusQueryable(80) is SUCCEED-only smoke.
Timing side-channel EXPECT_LT(ratio,5.0) at 72 (comment intends 2x). Disclosure oracles are 3-token blocklists (97/127). Unicode-path tests (184/222) genuine.
SaveIncremental(145) claims to lock signature byte-range but only checks file-exists. EncryptionManagerSurfacesPermissions(339) is a codec self-round-trip. ConvertToPdfA(253) decent.

STRONGEST security file. Real enforcement: password-strip THROWS + file not created (162), exporter returns false + no file (225), clipboard sentinel unchanged on copy-deny (434), print refuses before render. Positive controls + toggle-cleared negatives.
Verifier constructed + vtable-non-null (119), never runs check_digest/check_certificate on content. PFX DN read is real. No tamper case.

Has negatives (empty + 128-zero-byte -> digestValid=false) but garbage is all-zeros (structurally invalid). Valid path asserts only certChain non-empty, never digestValid=true. Size window 100..100000 (197).
Undo/redo command pattern; countSignatures() delta is sole oracle. No signing/verification exercised.

SignAndVerify(289)/VerifyAllSignatures(330) assert digestValid=true (positive half); VerifyUnsignedField(391) real negative. But SignField(242)/SaveIncremental(416) NO_THROW-only. No byte-tamper negative here.
POD/value-object unit tests; isFullyValid() rollup correctly tested per false axis. No crypto (not this layer's job).

TamperingFlippedByte(146)+ReportsModified(204) are REAL sign->valid/tamper->invalid. BUT cert-trust tests (expired/self-signed/intermediate 375/425/484) use 4-way ORs a self-signed cert satisfies unconditionally + SUCCEED escape hatches. Trust-chain never positively verified.
'Signed'/'Unsigned' column reflects a bool the test set (79), not a verification result. Panel showing 'Signed' for a tampered sig would pass.
TamperedPkcs7Rejected(235) solid. BUT TamperedPkcs7NotFullyValid(310) has operator-precedence defect '&b == 0' (never null) -> always writes 0x00; if target byte already 0x00 the tamper is a no-op.

Content-tamper->Invalid tested for P1/P2/P3 (real). BUT DocMDP semantic enforcement never tested negatively: no test that a DISALLOWED edit under P1/P2 is FLAGGED. Presence-only via fileContains('/DocMDP','/P N').
Entirely no-throw + grep-for-marker. Not one verifySignature call. Cryptographically-broken invisible /Sig would pass all 8.
Negative-byte-range regression guard; CertByteRangeValid(53)+ApprovalNoDocMdp(134) assert digestValid=true on reopen. Positive-only, no tamper here.
MISFILED for crypto audit: 'Tm sign' = numeric sign of text-matrix Tm.d (upside-down-text bug), NOT digital signatures. Strong algebraic/round-trip oracles. Zero security relevance.
7-day OCSP boundary 'rejected' = EXPECT_NE(LtvValidated) masked by always-UntrustedChain self-signed path. 'Accepted' = EXPECT_NE(InvalidSignature) (near anything). No revoked->REVOKED here.
Structural /DSS writer coverage (dict/VRI/byte-prefix). WriteMultipleCerts(291) 'distinct' certs are byte-identical (dup ^= 0x00 no-op). Honestly structural, no revocation semantics claimed.

STRONGEST LTV file. RevokedCertReturnsRevoked(464) EXPECT_EQ(Revoked). VerifiesLtvWithDss(388) requires explicit trust anchor + good OCSP. CustomTrustAnchor(533) has empty-store control. GAP: no forged-GOOD-untrusted-responder negative.

isTsaReachable(39) only checks a local file exists (never touches network). Timestamp-token OID result is LOGGED not asserted (146) - 'bonus best-effort'. TSA timestamping could be wholly broken, file stays green.
DocTimeStamp token 'valid ASN.1' = first byte==0x30 only (76). Token never parsed, TSA sig never checked, imprint never matched to /ByteRange digest. Garbage-but-0x30-prefixed token passes.

REAL VALUE: SSRF-guard negatives against real TsaClient (LocalhostRejected 170, LoopbackIp 178, MetadataEndpoint 185 169.254.169.254, FileScheme 193, FtpScheme 200). TSA response-parse tests (82/139) are OpenSSL i2d/d2i self-round-trips (never call TsaClient).

StaleRevokedOcspStillHonoured(322) genuine EXPECT_EQ(Revoked). BUT staleness/expiry ACCEPT-vs-REJECT tests (279/303/362/385) all EXPECT_NE(LtvValidated) on permanently-untrusted chain; own comments (283-284) concede 'both end up UntrustedChain'. FIX-OCSP-VALIDATOR guards don't guard the fix.
Parser round-trip only. Fixture OCSP always GOOD, CRL empty-revoked-list. No test that a revoked serial is surfaced as revoked.
OCSP unknown/stale/expired all EXPECT_NE(LtvValidated) masked by untrusted chain (330/349/369). Encrypt-metadata tests (253/281) genuine round-trips.
Enforces signing params: SIG02(280) asserts digestValid+Okay+!modifiedAfterSigning; SIG03(358) wrong password cannot yield verifying /Sig; empty-password accepted-count==0 (130). Strong.
Pure geometry/reparent structural guards (findChild!=null, height<=600). Legit for RDP-fit purpose; no signature semantics.
Toolbar/palette structural wiring (QAction!=null, dragDropMode). FieldTypeActionsAreExclusive(54) asserts real QActionGroup exclusivity. No crypto (included for completeness).

BEST encryption file. REAL negatives: WrongPassword_Throws(262), Authenticate_Wrong->level 0 (316). AES-256 asserts version=5/rev=6/method=AES-256 (281). Permission asserts are read-back proxy though.

Strong AES/RC4 keyLength+method round-trips. WrongPasswordDoesNotSilentlyOpen(151) real. BUT every 'permission enforced' test (410/458) is a getPermissions() flag echo; Rc4_40WrongPasswordFails(295) accepts isEncrypted==true as rejection (near-tautological).
Pure POD struct/bitmask setter/getter echoes. Only the PDF permission-bit constants (68-79) lock a real truth. High assert count, ~zero power to catch a crypto defect (honestly scoped though).

AlgorithmMapping tests (336/349/362) are combo-index->enum echoes. GENUINE value: PasswordMismatch(154/199) asserts OK disabled + 'do not match' label; PasswordStrength(375). SetUp GTEST_SKIP skips ALL if no QApplication.
Not annotation/crypto. Real metamorphic: DPI/font-size ~2x scaling, W>2*i, bad-font->0. 11 GTEST_SKIP -> inert on font-less CI.
Color asserted on data model (currentData().color, 36), annotation never rendered. Real signal-emission guards (no-emit-on-same 57, invalid-color-ignored 111). All GTEST_SKIP without QApplication.

Strong TRUE math: 3-4-5 distance, shoelace area, winding invariance, unit conversions, area scale SQUARED (156). ParseRejectsMissingTag(188) negative. Save/reload uses semantic tag extraction (appropriate).
Dominantly widget-exists + no-throw. StampSurvivesSaveAndReload(105) is a bare annotation-count oracle; no geometry/contents/appearance. SetColor(38) SUCCEED-only.
Genuine string-transform oracles: {date}/{author} resolution, multiple-occurrence, empty-author, passthrough. End-to-end proves no literal {author}/{date} survives. Solid.

STRONG placement oracle: asserts device-space center-x via fitz stext bbox against non-zero MediaBox origin (85); font-collision test inspects page /Font dict to prove body Courier preserved + Helvetica added.

TEXT page-range logic genuinely tested. BUT IMAGE-watermark tests near-empty: RespectsPageRange(186) asserts nothing about the range; OpensCleanly(160) reopen-smoke. Image presence never pixel-verified (text-extraction blind to raster).
Strong geometric: detects horizontal mirror via stext quad direction against adversarial -100 Tz fixture; UntouchedNeighborUnchanged(124) asserts neighbor glyph argb/x/y/advance unchanged. No smells.
GOLD-STANDARD visual oracle: renders page + counts red-dominant pixels (218), re-renders after reopen (256). RejectsNullImage(312) real negative. Library import/retrieve (88) is echo.
Menu built via helper (no real right-click). All asserts = objectName/label existence. Reply/Delete could be wired to nothing and all 4 pass.
SetAnnotationPopulatesFields(122-191) genuine. NavigateToAnnotationSignal(213) asserts count==0 (NOT emitted); real emission deferred to python. Rest existence/no-throw.
STRONGEST comment UI: flatten() walks real QTreeWidget, asserts reply depth > parent depth (user-visible nesting). Reply path has direct-emit fallback (167).
/IRT reply-chain saved/reopened/re-resolved via getInReplyTo back to parent index (135). Genuine roundtrip re-parse. Error paths EXPECT_THROW.
PositionFlip(204/216) real flip semantics. BUT ColorTheming(169) checks stylesheet string not pixels; ReadOnlyDoesNotEmitChanges(359) never asserts changedSpy.count()==0 (name lies).
SetDocumentPopulatesTree(78) checks row text. Extract/Delete buttons only enable-state proxy; panel never actually extracts/deletes (byte-level in test_attachments.cpp).
DockVisibilityChangedSyncsToggleAction(73-79) real signal-wiring oracle. Rest construction existence.

STRONG. ExtractRoundTripIsByteExact(190). Path-traversal ACTUALLY asserted: sanitizeFilename strips ../ (66-91), extract() confined via weakly_canonical prefix (220). ListReportsSize(236) accepts -1 OR count.
STRONG. RetrieveEmbeddedPayloadByteExact(117) round-trips 256 binary bytes incl NUL; SaveAndReopen re-reads payload (176). ToolStoresConfiguration(211) is setter/getter echo.

HighlightFromSelection(129): assertion guarded by 'if(annotationWasCreated)'; empty selection -> no annotation -> zero assertions -> broken tool ships green. Tools verified only by callback-fired + type enum, never geometry/render. 8 GTEST_SKIP.

Real mutate->save->reopen->re-query. BUT /Rect geometry NEVER asserted after any roundtrip (only type/contents/color) -> rect could shift and all 12 pass. Ink only checks stroke count>=1 (185). Delete/modify negatives good.
Setter/getter echo against live AnnotationData model, no persistence/render (138/159/182). Acceptable unit layer (roundtrip+AP files cover persistence). Error paths genuine.
Solid undo/redo behavioral oracle: counts AND contents/color revert-and-reapply (174/231). Merge-by-key maps to real typing-coalesce. Good file.

Resize(262)/Paste(508) tests self-invoke the callback they assert fired (real drag path bypassed). FreeTextDefaultAppearance(346) asserts daFontName non-empty + daFontSize>0 only; set Helv/14.0/red never checked (daColor untested). StickyNotePlacement stronger.

BEST annotation oracle: reopens with FRESH raw MuPDF ctx, walks pdf_first_annot, asserts each carries real /AP/N XObject with non-degenerate /BBox overlapping /Rect in device space. Kills 'round-trips as data, paints as nothing'. Not appearance CONTENT (color/path).

ranked_weak_findings.user_visible_failure_missed: A regression re-introducing any of 21 replayed CVEs -- connecting to the attacker SMB share (CVE-2018-4993 NTLM leak), executing embedded /AA JavaScript (CVE-2021-30560), running injected font PostScript (CVE-2024-4367) -- ships GREEN as long as Document::open returns within 5-10s and doesn't throw. The catch-all try/catch (57-59) even hides an outright throw. No test asserts the attack was neutralized.

If MuJS were ever wired to a launch/openDoc transport, app.launchURL('file:///C:/Windows/System32/calc.exe') would spawn a process and this test still passes -- the only oracle is that fireKeystrokeEvent doesn't throw and pageCount() survives. The name promises a block it never verifies.

Entire suite only asserts the scanner reports NOTHING on a clean fixture. A ProhibitedFeatureScanner that is broken and never detects encryption/JavaScript/external-refs (always returns false/empty) passes every test -> PDF/A compliance scanning silently passes non-compliant documents with zero test failing.

Certificate trust-chain is NEVER positively validated. Every fixture is self-signed and MuPDF has no system trust-store (noted at 481), so certificateStatus is always non-Okay. The cert-trust tests assert only 'non-Okay OR !certValid OR !isFullyValid', which a self-signed cert satisfies unconditionally -> a signature from an untrusted/attacker-controlled issuer is indistinguishable from a trusted one; a broken trust check is never caught. Plus SUCCEED() early-returns and GTEST_SKIPs.

DocMDP permission ENFORCEMENT is never tested negatively. /DocMDP + /P N are only grep-checked in bytes; the only behavioral tests confirm ALLOWED changes keep the digest valid. There is NO test that a DISALLOWED change (content edit/annotation under P1 NoChanges, content change under P2 FormFillOnly) is FLAGGED as a violation. If enforcement silently permitted forbidden edits, all certification tests stay green while the guarantee is void.

OCSP staleness / CRL nextUpdate-expiry enforcement could be silently removed and these FIX-OCSP-VALIDATOR regression tests still pass, because the self-signed cert with useTrustAnchors=false yields UntrustedChain in ALL cases -> EXPECT_NE(LtvValidated) never depends on the freshness check (the tests' own comments 283-284 concede 'both end up as UntrustedChain'). A signature backed only by a 30-day-stale/expired revocation response could be accepted as fresh in production.

The tamper-injection line has an operator-precedence defect: 'f.write(&b == 0 ? "\x01" : "\x00", 1)' evaluates '&b == 0' (address of a stack var, never null) as always-false, so it unconditionally writes 0x00. If the byte at the 75% offset is already 0x00 the mutation is a no-op and the test asserts !isFullyValid() on an UNMODIFIED validly-signed doc -> a genuinely-broken verifier returning isFullyValid=true fails only by luck of the target byte. A tamper test that may not tamper is security theatre.

The RFC-3161 timestamp-token OID presence is only printed to stdout, never asserted ('bonus best-effort'), and the reachability gate merely checks a local file exists rather than the network. TSA timestamping could be completely non-functional (no token ever embedded) and this real-endpoint test still passes -> an unsigned-time signature presents as timestamped to users.

No test asserts a GOOD OCSP response signed by an UNTRUSTED/arbitrary responder is rejected. Fixtures self-sign the OCSP with the same cert and the code comment (341-342) states verifyWith 'doesn't gate on OCSP signer trust, only the certStatus value'. An attacker who strips the real revoked-status responder and injects a self-signed GOOD OCSP into /DSS would be reported as validly revocation-checked. Revoked-path oracle is genuine; the forged-GOOD negative is missing.

A redaction that visually masks but leaves the underlying text/glyphs recoverable in the saved PDF passes, because the only content oracle is absence of the literal string '/UndoStack'. The actual redacted secret is never searched for in the output bytes or extracted text.

SSRF via /GoToR UNC to an attacker SMB share (NTLM leak), an auto-navigable data:text/html script, or a re-exposed submitForm/exportDataObject exfil API would all still pass -- each oracle is only that open/render/fireKeystroke didn't throw. Names promise 'Rejected/NotExecuted/NotAvailable' the tests never verify.

NO test in any encryption file proves a permission-restricted operation is actually blocked. Every 'permission' assertion is a getPermissions() bitmask read-back. If a downstream copy/print path ignored the flag, or saveEncrypted wrote permission bits without binding them to the crypto dict, the user's copy/print restriction would silently not be enforced and all tests still pass. The test name literally says 'Enforced' while only reading the flag.

An image watermark applied to EVERY page (range filter broken) or to NO page passes: the only assertions are Document::open!=null and pageCount==3. The named even-pages-only contract is asserted nowhere -> a logo could be stamped on confidential pages meant to be excluded, suite green.

The highlight/text-markup tool never actually selects text (empty quads), so no annotation is created on drag -- the user drags over text and gets nothing. The only type assertion is inside 'if(annotationWasCreated)', so the completely-broken tool passes with zero assertions.

After save/reopen a FreeText box shows the wrong font, wrong size, or lost text color: the test set Helv/14.0/red but only asserts daFontName non-empty and daFontSize>0, and never checks daColor. Garbage-but-non-empty DA ships green.

A memory leak or heap-corruption in the PKCS7 signature-verification path (the code that decides whether a signature is trusted) is not caught -- the test loops 100x and asserts nothing; there is no allocation/RSS measurement despite the name. A signature-forgery or parser-OOB regression ships green as long as the process survives.

The PKCS#7 verifier is constructed and its vtable pointers checked non-null, but check_digest/check_certificate are NEVER invoked on real content. A verifier whose check_digest always returned 'valid' passes every test in this file. No tamper/negative crypto case at this layer.

Entire file's oracle is 'signing did not throw' plus grep-for-marker ('/Type/Sig','/DocMDP','/P 2'). No verifySignature is ever called. An invisible signature that reports VALID but whose digest is wrong passes all eight -- invisible signatures are a notable forgery/repudiation surface precisely because there's no visible appearance to prompt scrutiny.

Header states this locks signature byte-range preservation (UI-SIG-12), but a saveIncremental that corrupts or rewrites existing signature byte-ranges passes as long as it writes a non-empty file -> a broken incremental save that invalidates prior signatures ships green.

An annotation's position/size (/Rect) shifts or collapses on save -- a sticky note/shape reopens in the wrong place -- and every roundtrip test still passes, because no test asserts the reopened annotation's rect/geometry (only type, contents, color). Ink additionally only checks stroke count>=1, not the path.

The DocTimeStamp fixture token is validated only by first-byte 0x30 and string/hex greps; the TimeStampToken is never parsed, its TSA signature never checked, its message imprint never matched to the /ByteRange digest. A corrupted/mismatched timestamp that still begins with a SEQUENCE tag passes -> document-timestamp integrity regressions invisible.

These 'TSA response parsing' tests rebuild request/response with raw OpenSSL and round-trip i2d/d2i WITHOUT ever invoking PDFE's TsaClient parsing/verification. They validate OpenSSL, not PDFE -- a bug in PDFE's own TSA response handling (e.g. failing to detect a status=2 rejection) is not exercised.

Same masked-by-UntrustedChain pattern: OCSP 'unknown' handling and stale/expired rejection asserted only via EXPECT_NE(LtvValidated) on a chain never trustable -> a regression treating 'unknown' as 'good' or ignoring staleness would not be caught.

A genuine per-byte password-comparison timing side-channel with up to a 4.9x timing ratio passes (code allows 5.0x though the comment intends 2x). Conversely wall-clock noise over 5 iterations makes it flaky -- neither reliably catches a real oracle nor holds a tight bound.

Drag-resizing an annotation handle (or paste) produces no undo entry / no geometry change because the real SelectTool drag/paste path is broken: the test manually calls tool.annotationMoved(...)/annotationPasted(...) itself then asserts that callback fired. The production mouse path is never executed.

Right-click Reply or Delete in the comment panel does nothing (action not connected): the QActions exist with the right labels but wired to nothing. All four tests assert only objectName/label existence -> the dead menu ships green.

Stamp persistence proven only by counting annotations of type==Stamp (before+1==after). A stamp round-tripping at the wrong rect, with lost contents, or with no visible appearance stream would count and pass -> user's stamp could reopen blank or misplaced, suite green.

A read-only sticky-note popup still fires contentsChanged and silently mutates a locked annotation: despite its name, the test never asserts changedSpy.count()==0 -- only checks isReadOnly()==true. The no-emit guarantee is untested.

13 tests are PermissionFlags/EncryptionSettings/EncryptionInfo struct+bitmask echoes; they cannot detect any actual encryption defect (wrong algorithm applied, key not derived, password not bound). High assert density gives a false impression of crypto coverage; only bit-constant asserts (68-79) lock a real spec truth. Risk = mis-attributed coverage.
